readmeHtml:
中国独立开发者项目列表

聚合所有中国独立开发者的项目

子版面

  • 程序员版面：使用需要命令行或写代码
  • 游戏版面：都是游戏
  • 更早的项目（2018 ~ 2024 年）：项目太多，从主列表单独分出一册

备注：您当前查看的是主版面，收录的产品是打开即用，和子版面中的产品类型不同。

1. 为什么有这个表 作为开发者其实比较好奇其他人在做什么业余项目（不管目的是做到盈利/玩票/试试看） 所以特意建了这个库。欢迎各位开发者把自己的项目加进来~ 发 Pull Request 或 Issue 即可
（入选标准：必须是网站或App，不能是开发者工具或论坛型网站）

写好介绍语很重要：❌ AI 视频生成工具 → ✅ 无需剪辑经验，3 步生成竖屏短视频
👉 如何写好一句话产品介绍

2. 项目有 3 种状态

开发中 已上线 已关闭或缺乏维护
🕗 ✅ ❌

aiSummary.oneLiner: Curated directory of projects created by Chinese independent developers, focusing on ready-to-use websites and apps.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This project is a centralized, community-maintained directory that aggregates software products built by independent Chinese developers. It specifically focuses on cataloging user-facing products like websites and mobile applications that are 'ready-to-use', explicitly excluding developer tools and forums. The repository categorizes projects into different domains such as games and utilities, and tracks their operational status (active, launched, or closed). The goal is to foster a sense of community among solo creators and provide a platform to discover interesting side projects and profitable micro-SaaS applications built by individuals.
keyFeatures: Project curation: Catalogs hundreds of independently developed applications and websites by Chinese creators.
Status tracking: Clearly marks projects as currently in development, successfully launched, or abandoned.
Strict inclusion criteria: Excludes developer tools to maintain a focus on end-user products and micro-SaaS.
Categorized sub-boards: Organizes complex or niche projects like games and CLI tools into separate specialized lists.
Community submissions: Allows developers to submit their own projects via standard GitHub pull requests.
